page.notes: Greek entries are reproduced approximately from a small, faded scan; accents and some letters at lines 8, 19, 3 and 4 are doubtful. Right column corrections are set in a lighter type; "tolle punctum." is cut off at the bottom edge of this part. Line 5 entry at the foot is partly cropped. The Greek words are transcribed as best they can be read; the scan is faint and partly obscured, so the Greek in the lines "scrib." and "corr. ἀπαναστάς" and "leg. βαχτ." is doubtful. The Greek fragment at the lower left, partly hidden, reads roughly "ἀπ. ʃ. ραβδος" and is illegible in part. Several errata lines are italic and are marked as such by the printed type.
